title: MMIE: MASSIVE MULTIMODAL INTERLEAVED COMPREHENSION BENCHMARK FOR LARGE VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing automated scoring models (such as the proposed MMIE-Score, GPT-4o, etc.) against human annotations using metrics like mean square error (MSE), mean absolute error (MAE), and Pearson correlation to detect systematic scoring deviations or biases in automated evaluation.

Qualitative error analysis of model failures to evaluate the strong tendency (bias) of Large Vision-Language Models to process and rely on surface-level textual cues rather than extracting nuanced information from visual data.
